sector: Direct to consumer daily greens powder sold online on a monthly subscription, creator seeded.
founded_place_size: Founded 2023, Portland, Oregon, online only, a small founder led team with a growth lead and three seeded creators.
about: Halden Greens is a daily greens powder people actually keep drinking, sold by subscription to buyers who have already been let down by a supplement that promised too much. We grow by putting the product in real kitchens and letting real people talk, not by looking like an advert. That distrust of polish is the brand.
audience: Health literate adults 25 to 40 who are specifically wary of supplement marketing and trust a friend's recommendation over a glossy campaign.
price_positioning: Fifty nine dollars a month on subscription. Priced as a considered daily habit, above the fifteen dollar tub and below the studio shot premium brands. The money is real, so the look must never be.

palette.name: Halden Green
palette.usage: The solid closing panel of every ad, the fixed brand green panel that every cutout holds against, carrying the subscription line and the wordmark. The wordmark's 2 px rule wherever the wordmark sits off this panel. Never a hook or caption colour and never a caption box.

palette.name: Mint Lid
palette.usage: Small marks and dividers only, echoing the tub's pale mint lid. Never type, a caption box or a panel.

palette.name: Kitchen Cream
palette.usage: All type on the Halden Green closing panel, the subscription line and the wordmark letters included, and the wordmark's 2 px rule on that panel; hook and caption type set straight on footage or on a Counter Charcoal box; and the light caption box that carries Counter Charcoal type.

palette.name: Counter Charcoal
palette.role: mandatory where type sits on Kitchen Cream
palette.usage: Hook and caption type on a Kitchen Cream box, as the current tub sets its dark wordmark on cream, or set straight on footage, and the dark caption box that carries Kitchen Cream type. Never the closing panel.

palette.name: Clay Accent
palette.usage: Small marks and dividers only. Never type, a caption box or a panel.

typography: Halden Greens sets everything in Figtree and everything in lowercase. Hooks set Figtree Regular at 62 px on 76 px leading, tracked minus 0.010 em. The subscription line sets Figtree SemiBold at 46 px on 56 px with tracking at zero, and at that same step sits the one exception in the system, the wordmark HALDEN GREENS in Figtree Regular capitals tracked plus 0.180 em on a 2 px Halden Green rule exactly as wide as the word GREENS. Captions set Figtree Regular at 40 px on 58 px, tracking zero, no more than 65 characters a line, and the compliance line sets Figtree Regular at 26 px on 34 px, tracked plus 0.030 em. The tub prints 11 pt on 15 pt. No hook is ever set in capitals, and no capital opens a sentence anywhere.
voice: Conversational, honest to a fault, a little self aware, never hype. Example: "We are not going to tell you it changed our life. It is greens. You drink them in the morning."
brand_assets_status: The wordmark exists only as a flat export, dark disjoint letters on white, with no vector source. The brand green panel is fixed and every cutout has to hold against it. Some earlier photography still shows a previous tub label and should not be reused.
values: Say only what we can stand behind. Claims live inside the category compliance sheet, and anything the sheet forbids does not run, however good the line.

type_system.signature_move: The capitals ban. HALDEN GREENS is the only text in the whole system ever set in capitals, Figtree Regular tracked plus 0.180 em above a 2 px Halden Green rule exactly as wide as the word GREENS, while every hook, caption and compliance line stays lowercase, with no capital even opening a sentence, so a viewer reads typing rather than advertising.
rules: Never set a hook in capitals.
Only the wordmark HALDEN GREENS ever sets in capitals; nothing else does, not even the first word of a sentence and not a proper noun in a caption.
The wordmark tracks plus 0.180 em and sits on a 2 px Halden Green rule exactly the width of the word GREENS, never wider and never narrower.
One family throughout, Figtree; only the subscription line lifts to SemiBold, and hooks stay Regular.
Claims live inside the category compliance sheet, and anything the sheet forbids does not run, however good the line.
The tub prints 11 pt on 15 pt.
Nothing in the type may look polished enough to read as an advert.

palette_rules.distribution: Halden Green is the one full ground: the solid closing panel. On it, all type, the subscription line and the wordmark letters included, is Kitchen Cream, and so is the wordmark's 2 px rule, because a Halden Green rule cannot show on Halden Green; that is the only place the rule is not Halden Green. Hooks and captions are Kitchen Cream or Counter Charcoal and nothing else; a box behind one is solid Kitchen Cream carrying Counter Charcoal type, or solid Counter Charcoal carrying Kitchen Cream type, as the current tub sets its dark wordmark on cream. Mint Lid and Clay Accent are optional accents for small marks and dividers only, never type, a box or a panel, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient, vignette or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over the footage: any box behind a hook or caption is a solid block.
palette_rules.forbidden: No gradient, glow, drop shadow, metallic, glossy or 3D effect on any type, box, panel, rule or icon, and no countdowns, no stacked badges, no burst text, because nothing in the type may look polished enough to read as an advert. No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, boxes, panels, rules or icons.
palette_rules.photography: Footage keeps its own colour and exposure and is never tinted, filtered or graded toward Halden Green or any palette colour. The bright kitchens in halden_creator_clip_01.mp4, halden_creator_clip_02.mp4, halden_creator_clip_03.mp4, halden_creator_clip_04.mp4 and halden_creator_clip_05.mp4 stay bright and the dark grounds in halden_founder_broll_01.mp4, halden_founder_broll_02.mp4, halden_founder_broll_03.mp4 and halden_founder_broll_04.mp4 stay dark: no take is brightened or darkened to carry a caption. The tub is never recoloured.
